messages.author: cd0e996b8e7408e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Error with setting account info
parts:
Looks like the that was locale issue.
Changed locale to En: 
Sys.setlocale(category = "LC_ALL", locale = "C")
...and everything worked fine.
At the begining locale was set to Ru (default for my PC):
locale:
[1] LC_COLLATE=Russian_Russia.1251  LC_CTYPE=Russian_Russia.1251   
[3] LC_MONETARY=Russian_Russia.1251 LC_NUMERIC=C                   
[5] LC_TIME=Russian_Russia.1251

Hope, it helps.
